exposure: Effective communication (EC) during labor and delivery
cohort: One hundred twenty women participating in a trial, randomly assigned to an intervention or control group.
finding: Implementing respectful maternity care and effective communication during labor and birth significantly reduces the Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Score.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in PPD results between the intervention and control groups regarding delivery mode.
followup_time: Six to eight weeks after delivery
